tiers.everyday: Great Paul, cast in 1881, is one of the heaviest bells ever made in Britain at about 17 tonnes. It hangs at St Paul's Cathedral in London.
tiers.student: St Paul's gives Great Paul as 16.75 tons, cast in 1881 by John Taylor & Co, note E flat; it is now swung by hand. The cathedral also has a ring of 12 (Taylor, 1878) and Great Tom, a clock bell of over 5 tons cast in 1716 by Richard Phelps of Whitechapel.
